title: Presymplectic BV-AKSZ and constrained DGCAs
summary: The AKSZ construction encodes the Batalin-Vilkovisky formulation of a topological field theory in terms of finite-dimensional geometric data. There are at least two ways to extend this approach to nontopological gauge theories. The first, due to Costello, replaces the spacetime exterior algebra with a more general DGCA that is not freely generated. The second replaces the symplectic structure with a degenerate presymplectic structure, which may also be non-regular.
